notes.title: August playtest update
notes.notes:
It has been a quiet couple of months since our last online playtest back in June. We've been working hard on this new build, and also on our pitch and preparations for Gamescom. We travel to Germany in less than a weeks time!

 
So what's new in this playtest?
2x new bosses

Voyage selection screen

Intro cinematic

First death "contract signing" scene

Save system improvements

A dedicated "insult" button

'Combo': a new enemy status effect

There are also 3+ new Steam achievements to unlock! Share your progress with the crew in our discord channel.

 
Accessing the playtest
If you would like to play, please fill out this sign up form to get sent a key.
